decisions.rationale: Keep the calendar-aligned 10 MCQ, 3 coding tasks and 40 minutes. List only a balanced representative objective set that those items will directly elicit, each mapped to MCQ or coding; drop objectives no item checks.

Merged with sme-02. State resources per part exactly as the frozen calendar supports: the coding part is without AI (F3 block 'Timed, without AI'); the MCQ part carries no AI restriction from the calendar. Name the provided terminal, POSIX shell and Git for coding. Any further resource rule (notes, web, built-in help) is set and shown by the platform assessment owner; say so explicitly rather than inventing policy in the repository.

Reclassify foundations-course-check as kind review with an explicitly formative review title; apply the review companion policy (HTML and Markdown required; GIFT, video, PDF and lab absent with reasons). Keep it separate from the course assessment blueprint. The page title and metadata follow in the ai-foundations module PR.

Add commits-diffs-and-gitignore as a prerequisite and make the undo objective self-contained around shared versus local history without relying on later remote mechanics. The page header follows in the git-foundations module PR, where module critics check it against the page bytes.
Retitle to 'Rules of use: what to share and redact' so the title matches the objectives; the page title follows in the ai-foundations module PR.

The approved plan section 3.5 explicitly lists calendar identity as dayId, kind, formats, passMark and weights for blueprint.json; the pass mark is published in the learner-facing calendar (F3 assessment passMark 70) and is not a key, rubric or score secret. The intake copied it verbatim and invented no weight or cut score; the schema requires both fields. Keep passMark and the empty weights object as calendar identity.
See education-02: scope the no-AI rule to the coding part only, matching the calendar's 'Timed, without AI' block; do not extend it to the MCQ part.

Correct the merge-vs-rebase objective: a merge of diverged histories creates a merge commit, while a fast-forward merge only moves the branch pointer. The page header follows in the git-foundations module PR.

Qualify the secret-handling objective: .env must be ignored before it is ever tracked because .gitignore does not affect tracked files, and a committed secret must be revoked or rotated; do not imply environment variables are a secret store. The page header follows in the linux-foundations module PR.

Correct the permissions objective: running a script directly (./script.sh) needs execute permission, while bash script.sh reads it and does not. The page header follows in the linux-foundations module PR.

Add official provider data-use sources for the AI products the ai-rules-of-use topic teaches (for example the Claude Code data-usage page and GitHub Copilot's data handling documentation), fetched live with retrieval time and hash in source-snapshot.json and listed in intake.md.
